_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#000.dst: 帶著你的 Gavel 護照到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找飛船事務員。

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.dst: 日安，大兵！今天要搭我們的船嗎？
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.dst: 可以讓我看一下你的護照嗎？
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: 有點灰塵呢！看起來很舊了，不過照片確實是你。
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.dst: 好，一切都沒問題，請上船，祝你旅途愉快。
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: 各位乘客請就座。我們馬上就要起飛了！
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#007.dst: 與 Captain Ackbar 談談失蹤孩童的事。

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: 各位乘客請注意。船上有人通報失蹤人口。若有志願者願意協助搜尋，請前往艦橋向船長報到。
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee waiting at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.dst: 起飛期間本區域禁止乘客進入。請上到客艙層，會有服務員在你的房間等候。
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#010.src: I hope I do not get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#010.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#011.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#011.dst: 你好啊，年輕的冒險者。你有沒有看到我的眼鏡？
Flight in Distress#011.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#012.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#013.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#013.dst: 日安，大兵！這趟航程這裡就是你的房間。祝你旅途愉快！
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#014.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#014.dst: 如果你沒別的事要做，也可以在這裡一路睡到目的地！
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#015.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#015.dst: 這裡供應的食物糟透了！簡直像是給他們關在下層的野獸吃的。
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#016.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#016.dst: *啜泣*……你有看到我的孩子嗎？我們本來在房間裡，然後他就這樣不見了！
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#017.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#017.dst: 我聽說有一艘大船從北邊靠過來。我在入口甲板看到的。不曉得他們想幹嘛。
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#018.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#018.dst: 你是來志願協助尋找那個失蹤孩子的嗎？
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#019.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#019.dst: 我們才剛啟航就出事了。
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#020.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#020.dst: 他母親說她兒子一上船沒多久就不見了。
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#021.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#021.dst: 要我說，這是父母沒管好。唉，總之我們得把那孩子找出來。
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#022.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#022.dst: 既然完全沒有線索，或許先去問問其他乘客會比較好。
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#023.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#023.dst: 他們大部分應該都在餐廳或交誼廳。
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#024.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: 非常感謝你的幫忙，希望你早點找到那孩子。
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#025.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#025.dst: 向乘客們打聽，試著找出失蹤孩童的下落。

Flight in Distress#026.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: 喂！你看遠處那艘船。從我們出發到現在，它幾乎一直跟著我們。
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#027.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#027.dst: 我知道我不該跑到下面來，可是……
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#028.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: 我超喜歡飛船的，而且我從來沒看過那種樣子的。
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#030.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#032.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#032.dst: 太感謝你找到我的孩子了！剩下的行程他都不准離開我半步。
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#033.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#033.dst: 對不起，剛剛害大家擔心了……
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#034.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#034.dst: 又見面了，你找到他了嗎？
Flight in Distress#034.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#035.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#035.dst: 他怎麼會跑到下面去的？！那裡明明該有人在值班！
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#036.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#036.dst: 太感謝你把他找回來了。你是唯一一個志願幫忙的人。
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#037.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#037.dst: 希望這趟航程就這麼一個小插曲。
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#038.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#038.dst: 老天爺啊，那是什麼聲音？船員，回報！
Flight in Distress#038.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#039.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#039.dst: 長官！我們有一具引擎爆了！那一側完全失去推力。
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#040.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#040.dst: 該死！沒有兩具引擎，我們就只能在這裡動彈不得。
Flight in Distress#040.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#041.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#042.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#042.dst: 大兵，去輪機艙向工程師報到，看看你能不能幫上什麼忙，讓這艘船重新動起來。
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#043.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#043.dst: 去看看工程師有沒有什麼事需要你幫忙。

Flight in Distress#044.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#044.dst: 你就是船長跟俺說的那個人類吧。
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#045.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: 俺們下面這邊的狀況可真不小。
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#046.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: 俺得守在這裡顧著引擎，不然這老姑娘可能會把自己搞壞。
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#047.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#047.dst: 人類，你要是想幫忙，就爬上索具去看看那幾具螺旋槳。
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#048.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: 從艦橋的檢修口可以上去。
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#049.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: 要是它們停了，把跳脫的斷路器扳回去就行。
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#050.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#050.dst: 弄完回來這裡找俺。俺得待著替她降溫。
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#051.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: 找出並修好飛船引擎的問題。引擎在氣囊頂端，從艦橋可以上去。

Flight in Distress#052.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#052.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#053.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#053.dst: 作業人員須在引擎過熱前重啟所有木製開關。
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#054.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#055.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: 回報 Engineer Eric，告訴他引擎修好了。

Flight in Distress#056.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#057.dst: 沒有你俺可弄不完這個。
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#058.dst: 你回房間去休息吧。像你這樣的乘客本來就不該幫船員做事。
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: 希望你剩下的旅程順利。俺會跟船長說一聲，讓他把馬力開到最大，咱們再上路。
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#063.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#063.dst: 全體船員各就各位！這不是演習！全體船員各就各位！
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#064.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#064.dst: 探索下層甲板，查明爆炸的原因。

Flight in Distress#065.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#065.dst: 撐住啊老姑娘，你辦得到的！
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#066.dst: 弟兄們，穩住她。我們還活得下來！只要能甩掉後面那些人就好。
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#068.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#068.dst: 姑娘們看啊，肉自己送上門來了！
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#069.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#069.dst: 再派人進去！他們沒辦法把我們全解決掉！
Flight in Distress#069.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#070.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#070.dst: 你們其他人，全給我進來！
Flight in Distress#070.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#072.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#072.dst: 我聽到打鬥聲？有人在嗎？我被關在牢房裡！
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#074.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#074.dst: 我聽見上面在打了，幹得好！能看到那群劫掠者遭報應，我這把老骨頭聽了都暖起來。
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#075.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#075.dst: 我以前可是全 Gavel 最厲害的鎖匠！我當年名聞遐邇——很不幸地。
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#076.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#076.dst: 這幫惡徒好幾年前抓走了我，逼我替他們的劫掠打造上百把鑰匙。
Flight in Distress#076.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#077.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#077.dst: 我現在太老了，但在離開這個世界之前，我真想親眼看到他們垮台。
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#078.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#078.dst: 我的製鑰工具收在走廊底端、樓梯後面。你可以用它們做出進入女王艙房的鑰匙。
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#079.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#079.dst: 往鎖孔裡看，就知道該怎麼做了。祝你好運！
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#080.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#080.dst: 製作能通往 Skyraider 女王的鑰匙。

Flight in Distress#081.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#081.dst: 所以你覺得你可以就這樣闖上我的船，是吧？
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#082.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#082.dst: 殺我的手下？打斷我的搶劫？
Flight in Distress#082.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#083.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#083.dst: 你這種「麻煩」，我知道該怎麼處理！
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#084.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: 擊敗 Skyraider 女王，並帶走她的一件私人寶物。

Flight in Distress#085.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#085.dst: 逃離該船，並與 Captain Ackbar 交談。

Flight in Distress#086.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: 哇，你憑一己之力擋下了一整場 Skyraider 的入侵。
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#087.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#087.dst: 而你還只是個乘客！你做得太好了……
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#088.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#088.dst: 這艘船上完全沒有防衛能力。我們只是民用客船。
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#089.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#089.dst: 這是什麼？女王的戒指？看起來很值錢。你應該留著。
Flight in Distress#089.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#090.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#090.dst: 我實在不知道該怎麼謝你……我們欠你太多了。
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#091.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#091.dst: 等等！我知道了！你可以免費搭乘{p}到{p}的航班！
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#092.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#092.dst: 有個叫 Calo 的私人飛船船主欠我一個大人情。
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#093.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#093.dst: 我會跟他說好這件事。你只要上他的船，他就會載你來回！
Flight in Distress#093.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#094.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: 喔，另外也會有一筆優厚的酬勞給你。戒指我會親自送過去給他，免得路上弄壞了，你到那邊再拿。
Flight in Distress#094.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#095.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: 你直接下到入口甲板就好，我們馬上就要抵達{p}空軍基地了。
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#097.dst: 下到入口甲板，然後下船。

Flight in Distress#098.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#098.dst: 到{p}碼頭那艘小船旁邊與 Calo 交談。

Flight in Distress#099.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: 你好啊。你一定就是 Ackbar 跟我提過的那個人類。
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#100.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#100.dst: 我聽說了你在船上做的事，非常了不起。算你走運，我欠 Ackbar 一份人情。
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#101.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: 你什麼時候想走，我都可以載你從{p}到{p}，反過來也行。
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#102.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#102.dst: 你只要上我的船就好。喔，這個也是 Ackbar 要給你的。
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Calo
